answer: The voyage register is checked at draw time, oasis lists the eligible set, and vault seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 41 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 41 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. Collateral of 14 dollars is at risk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
